_comment: Identical to ic/nominal/params.json except coupling_j, the Ising exchange, multiplied by (1 + 1e-15) - about four ulps of binary64. The exchange enters H continuously, so the eigenbasis and every relaxation-tensor element move at round-off only; the nominal-versus-variant spread is the measured floor of this check. This check has no ODE integrator in its path - it is one eigendecomposition and one tensor assembly - so its floor is expected well below the evolution checks.
